chunks: As for these habitations, We destroyed them only when they transgressed; even so We had fixed a time for their annihilation.
ai.seo_question: Why did Allah destroy the ancient towns mentioned in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the divine principle of 'maw'id' (appointed time), illustrating that Allah's destruction of unjust communities like the people of Lut or 'Ad was not arbitrary but preceded by a fixed deadline for their repentance. It serves as a warning that divine punishment is inevitable once the term of grace expires, reinforcing the concept of 'adl' (justice) in the timing of the Hereafter.
